mutations.name: a failed gh reads as no PRs
mutations.find: if (exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`gh pr list exited ${exitCode}`);
kills: asking gh for the merged PRs on a branch rejects when gh exits non-zero, so park refuses rather than reading no PRs

mutations.name: a repo with no origin still asks gh
kills: asking gh for the merged PRs on a branch asks nothing of a repo with no origin, which has nowhere to hold a PR

mutations.name: a non-array answer is not called out
mutations.find:
if (!Array.isArray(prs)) throw new Error("gh pr list did not answer a JSON array");
  return prs.map(parseMergedPr);
kills: reading gh's merged PRs for a head branch (CC-1064) throws on an answer that is not a JSON array

mutations.name: a PR with no head commit is trusted
kills: reading gh's merged PRs for a head branch (CC-1064) throws on a PR without a head commit rather than trusting it
